reader.noLink: This address does not name a company. Ask a signer of the company for your reader link, and open that.
reader.signUp.title: Read a company's records
reader.signUp.intro: A signer of the company can give you read access to some of its records. Read access holds no seat and signs, sends and pays nothing: your wallet gives this page only the read keys your access names, for this company.
reader.signIn.why: Sign in with your wallet to make your reader code and to open the company.
reader.code.title: Your reader code
reader.code.hint: Your wallet makes a code for this company from a key it works out for it. Give the code to a signer of the company, and read them the fingerprint your wallet shows, so they know the code is yours. Once enough of the company's signers have signed, come back to this page and open the company.
reader.code.label: Your reader code
reader.open.title: Open the company
reader.open.hint: Your wallet reads the company's read grants and gives this page the read keys your access names, for this company only. Nothing is signed, sent or paid.
reader.closed.title: The company did not open
reader.why.no-grant: Your wallet found no read access for you that enough of the company's signers have signed, so it gave this page nothing. Ask a signer to give you access from their wallet, using a reader code from this page. Once enough signers have signed, open the company again.
reader.why.taken-away: The company's signers took your read access away, and enough of them signed it, so your wallet gave this page nothing. What you opened before stays with you. To get access again, ask a signer to give it from their wallet, using a reader code from this page. Once enough signers have signed, open the company again.
reader.why.not-a-reader-here: The company's service does not list you as one of its readers, or does not list what your access lets you read, so nothing was given. A signer of the company gives you read access from their wallet; once enough signers have signed, open the company again.
reader.why.not-read: Your wallet could not check the company's read grants against the company's records on the network, so it gave this page nothing. If the records could not be checked against their anchor, the next action a signer of the company makes in their wallet files a newer one; open the company again after it.
reader.why.not-on-chain: The company this link names has no account on the network, so nothing was opened. Ask a signer of the company for the reader link again.
reader.why.not-a-company: The link does not name a company your wallet can read, so nothing was opened. Ask a signer of the company for the reader link again.
reader.why.unreached: The company's service did not give this company's records, so nothing was opened. Try again in a minute; if it happens again, ask a signer of the company.
reader.why.not-the-companys: The company's service holds another label or contract address for this company than the link names, so nothing was opened. Ask a signer of the company for the reader link again.
reader.why.no-keys: This page holds no read keys for the company on this visit, so nothing was opened. Open the company with your wallet.
reader.why.other: Your wallet did not give this page your read keys, so nothing was opened. Open the company again.
reader.company.hint: This page names the company by the end of its label.
reader.asof: Shown as of the last time your wallet checked your access. When you check again, your wallet gives this page the keys your latest access wraps to you. If enough of the company's signers have taken your access away, it gives nothing and this page says so.
reader.runs.title: Payroll runs
reader.runs.none: The company has no payroll runs.
reader.runs.notInAccess: Your access does not include payroll runs, so none are shown.
reader.runs.unreadable: The payroll runs could not be read. Try again in a minute.
reader.runs.someNotOpened_one: {count} run could not be opened with the keys your wallet gave this page. A run sealed after the keys your access wraps needs read access given again by a signer.
reader.runs.someNotOpened_other: {count} runs could not be opened with the keys your wallet gave this page. A run sealed after the keys your access wraps needs read access given again by a signer.
reader.proposals.title: Proposals
reader.proposals.notInAccess: Your access does not include proposals, so none are shown.
reader.proposals.unreadable: The proposals could not be read. Try again in a minute.
